concerns.text: FR-001 mandates downloading from OQMD, AFLOW, AND Materials Project (if API key available). T006b explicitly hardcodes only OQMD and AFLOW HuggingFace IDs/URLs and lacks the conditional logic to attempt Materials Project ingestion or the fallback logic described in FR-008. No task covers the MP ingestion path.

FR-014 and SC-003 require a synthetic ground-truth dataset with known NON-LINEAR feature weights. T036 defines a static linear weight vector (`[0.5, 0.4, ...]`) and describes 'Gaussian noise' without specifying the non-linear transformation logic required to satisfy the 'non-linear' constraint in the spec.

FR-002 defines 'ImbalanceScore' as the Gini coefficient of compositional feature space derived from K-Means (k=50). T008 describes calculating the score but does not explicitly include a task to perform the K-Means clustering or extract the cluster assignments required to compute the Gini coefficient, risking an implementation gap.

FR-008 requires detecting if Materials Project data is unavailable and switching to a fallback mode (OQMD/AFLOW only) with logging. While T004 mentions logging API errors, no specific task implements the logic to detect MP unavailability and trigger the scope restriction/fallback mode defined in FR-008.

T004 specifies logging API errors with size-based rotation (100MB). While FR-007 mandates logging errors, it does not explicitly mandate log rotation or file size limits. This adds an implementation constraint not authorized by the spec, potentially complicating reproducibility if rotation logic differs.
